verses.original: עַל־ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֣י אֶעֱמֹ֔דָה וְאֶֽתְיַצְּבָ֖ה עַל־ מָצ֑וֹר וַאֲצַפֶּ֗ה לִרְאוֹת֙ מַה־ יְדַבֶּר־ בִּ֔י וּמָ֥ה אָשִׁ֖יב עַל־ תּוֹכַחְתִּֽי׃
verses.transliteration: ‘al- miš·mar·tî ’e·‘ĕ·mō·ḏāh wə·’eṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇāh ‘al- mā·ṣō·wr wa·’ă·ṣap·peh lir·’ō·wṯ mah- yə·ḏab·ber- bî ū·māh ’ā·šîḇ ‘al- tō·w·ḵaḥ·tî
verses.literal: I will stand at my guard post and station myself on the ramparts I will watch to see what He will say to me and how I should answer when corrected
verses.literalPt: SOBRE a minha guarda estarei, e sobre a fortaleza me apresentarei e vigiarei, para ver o que falará a mim, e o que eu responderei quando eu for argüido.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲנֵ֤נִי יְהוָה֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר כְּת֣וֹב חָז֔וֹן וּבָאֵ֖ר עַל־ הַלֻּח֑וֹת לְמַ֥עַן יָר֖וּץ ק֥וֹרֵא בֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·nê·nî Yah·weh way·yō·mer kə·ṯō·wḇ ḥā·zō·wn ū·ḇā·’êr ‘al- hal·lu·ḥō·wṯ lə·ma·‘an yā·rūṣ qō·w·rê ḇōw
verses.literal: Then the LORD . . . answered me Write down this vision and clearly inscribe it on tablets so that a herald may run with it
verses.literalPt: Então o SENHOR me respondeu, e disse: Escreve a visão e torna bem legível sobre tábuas, para que a possa ler quem passa correndo.

verses.original: כִּ֣י ע֤וֹד חָזוֹן֙ לַמּוֹעֵ֔ד וְיָפֵ֥חַ לַקֵּ֖ץ וְלֹ֣א יְכַזֵּ֑ב אִם־ יִתְמַהְמָהּ֙ חַכֵּה־ ל֔וֹ כִּֽי־ בֹ֥א יָבֹ֖א לֹ֥א יְאַחֵֽר׃
verses.transliteration: kî ‘ō·wḏ ḥā·zō·wn lam·mō·w·‘êḏ wə·yā·p̄ê·aḥ laq·qêṣ wə·lō yə·ḵaz·zêḇ ’im- yiṯ·mah·māh ḥak·kêh- lōw kî- ḇō yā·ḇō lō yə·’a·ḥêr
verses.literal: For the vision awaits an appointed time it testifies of the end and does not lie Though it lingers wait for it since it will surely come . . . and will not delay
verses.literalPt: Porque a visão é ainda para o tempo determinado, mas se apressa para o fim, e não enganará; se tardar, espera-o, porque certamente virá, não tardará.

verses.original: הִנֵּ֣ה עֻפְּלָ֔ה לֹא־ יָשְׁרָ֥ה נַפְשׁ֖וֹ בּ֑וֹ וְצַדִּ֖יק בֶּאֱמוּנָת֥וֹ יִחְיֶֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hin·nêh ‘up·pə·lāh lō- yā·šə·rāh nap̄·šōw bōw wə·ṣad·dîq be·’ĕ·mū·nā·ṯōw yiḥ·yeh
verses.literal: Look at the proud one his soul . . . is not upright but the righteous will live by faith
verses.literalPt: Eis que a sua alma está orgulhosa, não é reta nele; mas o justo pela sua fé viverá.

verses.original: וְאַף֙ כִּֽי־ הַיַּ֣יִן בּוֹגֵ֔ד גֶּ֥בֶר יָהִ֖יר וְלֹ֣א יִנְוֶ֑ה אֲשֶׁר֩ הִרְחִ֨יב כִּשְׁא֜וֹל נַפְשׁ֗וֹ וְה֤וּא כַמָּ֙וֶת֙ וְלֹ֣א יִשְׂבָּ֔ע וַיֶּאֱסֹ֤ף אֵלָיו֙ כָּל־ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם וַיִּקְבֹּ֥ץ אֵלָ֖יו כָּל־ הָעַמִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’ap̄ kî- hay·ya·yin bō·w·ḡêḏ ge·ḇer yā·hîr wə·lō yin·weh ’ă·šer hir·ḥîḇ kiš·’ō·wl nap̄·šōw wə·hū ḵam·mā·weṯ wə·lō yiś·bā‘ way·ye·’ĕ·sōp̄ ’ê·lāw kāl- hag·gō·w·yim way·yiq·bōṣ ’ê·lāw kāl- hā·‘am·mîm
verses.literal: and wealth indeed . . . betrays him He is an arrogant man never at rest He enlarges his appetite like Sheol and like Death he is never satisfied He gathers all the nations to himself and collects all the peoples as his own
verses.literalPt: Tanto mais que, por ser dado ao vinho é desleal; homem soberbo que não permanecerá; que alarga como o inferno a sua alma; e é como a morte que não se farta, e ajunta a si todas as nações, e congrega a si todos os povos.

verses.original: הֲלוֹא־ אֵ֣לֶּה כֻלָּ֗ם עָלָיו֙ מָשָׁ֣ל יִשָּׂ֔אוּ וּמְלִיצָ֖ה חִיד֣וֹת ל֑וֹ וְיֹאמַ֗ר ה֚וֹי הַמַּרְבֶּ֣ה לֹּא־ ל֔וֹ עַד־ מָתַ֕י וּמַכְבִּ֥יד עָלָ֖יו עַבְטִֽיט׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w- ’êl·leh ḵul·lām ‘ā·lāw mā·šāl yiś·śā·’ū ū·mə·lî·ṣāh ḥî·ḏō·wṯ lōw wə·yō·mar hō·w ham·mar·beh lō- lōw ‘aḏ- mā·ṯay ū·maḵ·bîḏ ‘ā·lāw ‘aḇ·ṭîṭ
verses.literal: Will not all of these take up a taunt against him speaking with mockery and derision Woe to him who amasses what is not his and makes himself rich with many loans How long will this go on
verses.literalPt: Não levantarão, pois, todos estes contra ele uma parábola e um provérbio sarcástico contra ele? E se dirá: Ai daquele que multiplica o que não é seu! (até quando?) e daquele que carrega sobre si dívidas!

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא פֶ֗תַע יָק֙וּמוּ֙ נֹשְׁכֶ֔יךָ וְיִקְצ֖וּ מְזַעְזְעֶ֑יךָ וְהָיִ֥יתָ לִמְשִׁסּ֖וֹת לָֽמוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w p̄e·ṯa‘ yā·qū·mū nō·šə·ḵe·ḵā wə·yiq·ṣū mə·za‘·zə·‘e·ḵā wə·hā·yî·ṯā lim·šis·sō·wṯ lā·mōw
verses.literal: Will not your creditors suddenly arise and those who disturb you awaken Then you will become their prey
verses.literalPt: Porventura não se levantarão de repente os teus extorquiadores, e não despertarão os que te farão tremer, e não lhes servirás tu de despojo?

verses.original: כִּֽי אַתָּ֤ה שַׁלּ֙וֹתָ֙ גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֔ים יְשָׁלּ֖וּךָ כָּל־ יֶ֣תֶר עַמִּ֑ים מִדְּמֵ֤י אָדָם֙ וַחֲמַס־ אֶ֔רֶץ קִרְיָ֖ה וְכָל־ יֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: kī ’at·tāh šal·lō·w·ṯā gō·w·yim rab·bîm yə·šāl·lū·ḵā kāl- ye·ṯer ‘am·mîm mid·də·mê ’ā·ḏām wa·ḥă·mas- ’e·reṣ qir·yāh wə·ḵāl yō·šə·ḇê ḇāh
verses.literal: Because you have plundered many nations the remnant of the people will plunder you because of your bloodshed against man and your violence against the land the city and all their dwellers . . .
verses.literalPt: Porquanto despojaste a muitas nações, todos os demais povos te despojarão a ti, por causa do sangue dos homens, e da violência feita à terra, à cidade, e a todos os que nela habitam.

verses.original: ה֗וֹי בֹּצֵ֛עַ בֶּ֥צַע רָ֖ע לְבֵית֑וֹ לָשׂ֤וּם בַּמָּרוֹם֙ קִנּ֔וֹ לְהִנָּצֵ֖ל מִכַּף־ רָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w bō·ṣê·a‘ be·ṣa‘ rā‘ lə·ḇê·ṯōw lā·śūm bam·mā·rō·wm qin·nōw lə·hin·nā·ṣêl mik·kap̄- rā‘
verses.literal: Woe to him who builds his house by unjust gain to place his nest on high and escape the hand of disaster
verses.literalPt: Ai daquele que, para a sua casa, ajunta cobiçosamente bens mal adquiridos, para pôr o seu ninho no alto, a fim de se livrar do poder do mal!

verses.original: יָעַ֥צְתָּ בֹּ֖שֶׁת לְבֵיתֶ֑ךָ קְצוֹת־ עַמִּ֥ים רַבִּ֖ים וְחוֹטֵ֥א נַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃
verses.transliteration: yā·‘aṣ·tā bō·šeṯ lə·ḇê·ṯe·ḵā qə·ṣō·wṯ- ‘am·mîm rab·bîm wə·ḥō·w·ṭê nap̄·še·ḵā
verses.literal: You have plotted shame for your house by cutting off many peoples and forfeiting your life
verses.literalPt: Vergonha maquinaste para a tua casa; destruindo tu a muitos povos, pecaste contra a tua alma.

verses.original: כִּי־ אֶ֖בֶן מִקִּ֣יר תִּזְעָ֑ק וְכָפִ֖יס מֵעֵ֥ץ יַעֲנֶֽנָּה׃פ
verses.transliteration: kî- ’e·ḇen miq·qîr tiz·‘āq wə·ḵā·p̄îs mê·‘êṣ ya·‘ă·nen·nāh
verses.literal: For the stones will cry out from the wall and the rafters will echo it from the woodwork
verses.literalPt: Porque a pedra clamará da parede, e a trave lhe responderá do madeiramento.

verses.original: ה֛וֹי בֹּנֶ֥ה עִ֖יר בְּדָמִ֑ים וְכוֹנֵ֥ן קִרְיָ֖ה בְּעַוְלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w bō·neh ‘îr bə·ḏā·mîm wə·ḵō·w·nên qir·yāh bə·‘aw·lāh
verses.literal: Woe to him who builds a city with bloodshed and establishes a town by iniquity
verses.literalPt: Ai daquele que edifica a cidade com sangue, e que funda a cidade com iniqüidade!

verses.original: הֲל֣וֹא הִנֵּ֔ה מֵאֵ֖ת יְהוָ֣ה צְבָא֑וֹת וְיִֽיגְע֤וּ עַמִּים֙ בְּדֵי־ אֵ֔שׁ וּלְאֻמִּ֖ים בְּדֵי־ רִ֥יק יִעָֽפוּ׃
verses.transliteration: hă·lō·w hin·nêh mê·’êṯ Yah·weh ṣə·ḇā·’ō·wṯ wə·yî·ḡə·‘ū ‘am·mîm bə·ḏê- ’êš ū·lə·’um·mîm bə·ḏê- rîq yi·‘ā·p̄ū
verses.literal: Is it not indeed from the LORD of Hosts that the labor of the people only feeds the fire and the nations weary themselves in vain
verses.literalPt: Porventura não vem do SENHOR dos Exércitos que os povos trabalhem pelo fogo e os homens se cansem em vão?

verses.original: כִּ֚י תִּמָּלֵ֣א הָאָ֔רֶץ לָדַ֖עַת אֶת־ כְּב֣וֹד יְהוָ֑ה כַּמַּ֖יִם יְכַסּ֥וּ עַל־ יָֽם׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî tim·mā·lê hā·’ā·reṣ lā·ḏa·‘aṯ ’eṯ- kə·ḇō·wḏ Yah·weh kam·ma·yim yə·ḵas·sū ‘al- yām
verses.literal: For the earth will be filled with the knowledge of the glory of the LORD as the waters cover . . . the sea
verses.literalPt: Porque a terra se encherá do conhecimento da glória do SENHOR, como as águas cobrem o mar.

verses.original: ה֚וֹי מַשְׁקֵ֣ה רֵעֵ֔הוּ מְסַפֵּ֥חַ חֲמָתְךָ֖ וְאַ֣ף שַׁכֵּ֑ר לְמַ֥עַן הַבִּ֖יט עַל־ מְעוֹרֵיהֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w maš·qêh rê·‘ê·hū mə·sap·pê·aḥ ḥă·mā·ṯə·ḵā wə·’ap̄ šak·kêr lə·ma·‘an hab·bîṭ ‘al- mə·‘ō·w·rê·hem
verses.literal: Woe to him who gives drink to his neighbors pouring it from the wineskin until they are drunk in order to gaze at their nakedness
verses.literalPt: Ai daquele que dá de beber ao seu companheiro! Ai de ti, que adiciona à bebida o teu furor, e o embebedas para ver a sua nudez!

verses.original: שָׂבַ֤עְתָּ קָלוֹן֙ מִכָּב֔וֹד שְׁתֵ֥ה גַם־ אַ֖תָּה וְהֵֽעָרֵ֑ל תִּסּ֣וֹב עָלֶ֗יךָ כּ֚וֹס יְמִ֣ין יְהוָ֔ה וְקִיקָל֖וֹן עַל־ כְּבוֹדֶֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: śā·ḇa‘·tā qā·lō·wn mik·kā·ḇō·wḏ šə·ṯêh ḡam- ’at·tāh wə·hê·‘ā·rêl tis·sō·wḇ ‘ā·le·ḵā kō·ws yə·mîn Yah·weh wə·qî·qā·lō·wn ‘al- kə·ḇō·w·ḏe·ḵā
verses.literal: You will be filled with shame instead of glory You too must drink and expose your uncircumcision The cup in the LORD’s right hand will come around to you and utter disgrace . . . will cover your glory
verses.literalPt: Serás farto de ignomínia em lugar de honra; bebe tu também, e sê como um incircunciso; o cálice da mão direita do SENHOR voltará a ti, e ignomínia cairá sobre a tua glória.

verses.original: כִּ֣י חֲמַ֤ס לְבָנוֹן֙ יְכַסֶּ֔ךָּ וְשֹׁ֥ד בְּהֵמ֖וֹת יְחִיתַ֑ן מִדְּמֵ֤י אָדָם֙ וַחֲמַס־ אֶ֔רֶץ קִרְיָ֖ה וְכָל־ יֹ֥שְׁבֵי בָֽהּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: kî ḥă·mas lə·ḇā·nō·wn yə·ḵas·se·kā wə·šōḏ bə·hê·mō·wṯ yə·ḥî·ṯan mid·də·mê ’ā·ḏām wa·ḥă·mas- ’e·reṣ qir·yāh wə·ḵāl yō·šə·ḇê ḇāh
verses.literal: For your violence against Lebanon will overwhelm you and the destruction of animals will terrify you because of your bloodshed against men and your violence against the land the city and all their dwellers . . .
verses.literalPt: Porque a violência cometida contra o Líbano te cobrirá, e a destruição das feras te amedrontará, por causa do sangue dos homens, e da violência feita à terra, à cidade, e a todos os que nela habitam.

verses.original: מָֽה־ הוֹעִ֣יל פֶּ֗סֶל כִּ֤י פְסָלוֹ֙ יֹֽצְר֔וֹ מַסֵּכָ֖ה וּמ֣וֹרֶה שָּׁ֑קֶר כִּ֣י בָטַ֞ח יֹצֵ֤ר יִצְרוֹ֙ עָלָ֔יו לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת אֱלִילִ֥ים אִלְּמִֽים׃ס
verses.transliteration: māh- hō·w·‘îl pe·sel kî p̄ə·sā·lōw yō·ṣə·rōw mas·sê·ḵāh ū·mō·w·reh šā·qer kî ḇā·ṭaḥ yō·ṣêr yiṣ·rōw ‘ā·lāw la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’ĕ·lî·lîm ’il·lə·mîm
verses.literal: What use is an idol that a craftsman should carve it or an image a teacher of lies For its maker trusts in his own creation . . . he makes idols that cannot speak
verses.literalPt: Que aproveita a imagem de escultura, depois que a esculpiu o seu artífice? Ela é máscara e ensina mentira, para que quem a formou confie na sua obra, fazendo ídolos mudos?

verses.original: ה֣וֹי אֹמֵ֤ר לָעֵץ֙ הָקִ֔יצָה ע֖וּרִי לְאֶ֣בֶן דּוּמָ֑ם ה֣וּא יוֹרֶ֔ה הִנֵּה־ ה֗וּא תָּפוּשׂ֙ זָהָ֣ב וָכֶ֔סֶף וְכָל־ ר֖וּחַ אֵ֥ין בְּקִרְבּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: hō·w ’ō·mêr lā·‘êṣ hā·qî·ṣāh ‘ū·rî lə·’e·ḇen dū·mām hū yō·w·reh hin·nêh- hū tā·p̄ūś zā·hāḇ wā·ḵe·sep̄ wə·ḵāl rū·aḥ ’ên bə·qir·bōw
verses.literal: Woe to him who says to wood Awake or to silent stone Arise Can it give guidance Behold it is overlaid with gold and silver yet there is no breath in it at all
verses.literalPt: Ai daquele que diz ao pau: Acorda! e à pedra muda: Desperta! Pode isso ensinar? Eis que está coberta de ouro e de prata, mas dentro dela não há espírito algum.

verses.original: וַֽיהוָ֖ה בְּהֵיכַ֣ל קָדְשׁ֑וֹ הַ֥ס מִפָּנָ֖יו כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃פ
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh bə·hê·ḵal qā·ḏə·šōw has mip·pā·nāw kāl- hā·’ā·reṣ
verses.literal: But the LORD is in His holy temple let all the earth be silent before Him
verses.literalPt: Mas o SENHOR está no seu santo templo; cale-se diante dele toda a terra.
